text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 37°C (98.6°F) (Stable). Cardiac Imaging (Echocardiogram): No significant findings reported to suggest congenital heart anomalies based on current context. Respiratory Imaging (Chest X-Ray review): Findings consistent with Hyaline Membrane Disease (Fine reticular granularity with ground glass appearance), indicating respiratory distress syndrome rather than apnea; no evidence of temperature instability noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS). The clinical picture of a 33-week preterm infant with distress starting within two hours of birth, normal maternal glucose, stable temperature, and a chest X-ray showing a ground-glass appearance with fine reticular granularity is diagnostic for Hyaline Membrane Disease.
